kret3f5n.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Snowy Pencil Christmas Tree
kret3f5n.sourceDescription: The Snowy Pencil Tree is the perfect choice for those looking to make a statement this festive season. With its stylish, sleek design it will instantly add a touch of class to your home or Business this Christmas through its fashionable, pencil-thin style. Not only are these pencil trees very much "on trend", they are also a great option for those who have limited space within their home and are searching for a tree that avoids looking cramped in smaller rooms. With flocked, pronged, delicate branches, this tree is perfect for hanging stunning small ornaments on to complete the look. Available in 7ft and as both a pre-lit tree and an un-lit tree and in three stunning colours, this range is perfect for homes, businesses and shop windows. z69fgpja.variantName: My Christmas 3ft Artificial PE Christmas Tree with 72 Tips - Green
z69fgpja.sourceDescription: Bring a natural, lifelike touch to your festive décor with this artificial Christmas tree, crafted entirely from premium polyethylene (PE) with moulded needles that recreate the texture and appearance of real pine. Its dense, full branches provide reliable support for Christmas baubles, garlands and lights while maintaining their shape throughout the festive season. Made from durable, flame-retardant PE, the tree is designed for repeated seasonal use with minimal needle shedding. The lightweight plastic stand provides stable support while making the tree easy to move and assemble. Supplied in three sections, it features hinged branches that open automatically when connected, allowing for quick setup and easy shaping. Specifications: Made from 100% PE with realistic moulded needles, dense branches, a durable flame-retardant construction and a lightweight plastic stand. Supplied in three sections with hinged branches for convenient assembly, storage and reuse. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

vw45tyhp.variantName: My Christmas 4ft Artificial Green Christmas Tree with 260 Tips - Green
vw45tyhp.sourceDescription: Bring festive charm to your home with this realistic green artificial Christmas tree, featuring lush PVC branches for a full, traditional appearance. Designed as a reusable alternative to a real tree, it has a sturdy metal frame and folding metal base to provide reliable support throughout the festive season. The tree comes in three hinged sections for straightforward assembly and convenient storage after use. Simply connect the sections, unfold the branches and shape them to achieve the desired fullness. Suitable for seasonal decorating, this durable tree can be styled with your favourite baubles, tinsel and Christmas lights. Mains-operated Christmas lights are available separately and can be used indoors or outdoors, provided the transformer remains indoors. Specifications: Made from PVC with a durable metal frame and folding metal base. Three hinged sections for easy assembly and storage. Christmas lights are sold separately. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

rbz03nav.baseName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
rbz03nav.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine Christmas Tree
rbz03nav.sourceDescription: Our MD's favourite! With a classic upturned shape and incorporating super lifelike PE plastic moulded branch tips, we love the final look of this 6ft pre-lit Christmas tree. The Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine's curved outer branches not only provide an eye-catching silhouette but they also create plenty of space to hang pretty Christmas tree decorations. Our customers love how full and bushy the Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine looks year after year. It is also one of our easiest 6ft Christmas trees to erect. That's thanks to the hinged and contoured branches that effortlessly fall into place (you just need to tweak the inner branches a little to fill the gaps) and the ready-lit branches. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. rg3wghvw.baseName: Charles Bentley 180cm Lifelike Pinecones Christmas Garland - Green
rg3wghvw.variantName: Charles Bentley 180cm Lifelike Pinecones Christmas Garland - Green
rg3wghvw.sourceDescription: Our 180cm Christmas garland with pinecones brings a classic, Scandi-inspired look to your home. Full, lifelike greenery is dotted with pinecones for a natural, cosy feel that lasts all season. Drape it over a fireplace, frame a doorway or wind it along the staircase, and it's ready to enjoy year after year. With a generous 180cm length and a pliable, easy-to-shape construction, this garland gives you the flexibility to style it exactly how you want, sweeping, arching, or draped loosely for a natural feel. The rich green foliage and pinecone detailing hold their shape and colour season after season. Lightweight and compact to store, it's a Christmas staple you'll reach for year after year, shaped in minutes and packing away just as easily once the festivities are over. Ideal for: Fireplace mantels, staircase banisters, doorways, window ledges, table centrepieces, and indoor Christmas displays. Please Note: For indoor use only. Keep away from open flame and heat sources. Features: • Creates an instantly festive scandi look – perfect for dressing mantels banisters doorways and windowsills • Rich green foliage with pinecone accents for a classic natural Christmas feel • Pliable easy-to-shape branches hold their position without the need for additional fixings • Durable plastic construction retains colour and form – no needle drop no mess • Lightweight and easy to handle – no tools or fixings required • Compact to store – folds down easily for convenient off-season storage Includes: • 1x Christmas Garland with Pinecones Materials: • Plastic (foliage and pinecone detailing) Weights: • 2kg Colours: • Green Additional Info: • Styling: Arrange over a mantelpiece or drape along a staircase banister for an instantly festive centrepiece. • Construction: Crafted from durable plastic with realistic foliage and pinecone detailing designed to look great season after season without wilting fading or shedding. • Storage: Fold gently and store in a cool dry place between seasons. Reshape branches each year for best results. • Care: Wipe with a dry or lightly damp cloth to remove dust. Do not expose to open flame. Dimensions: H25, W25, D180cm Warning: for indoor decorative use only. Keep away from open flames, heat sources and ignition sources. Do not allow children or pets to play with the garland. Secure it so it cannot fall or create a trip or entanglement hazard. Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ

pqrqmbnf.baseName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Gold Tinsel
pqrqmbnf.variantName: Christmas Tree World 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Gold Tinsel
pqrqmbnf.sourceDescription: Make a real statement this Christmas with our 50m Extra Thick Fire Retardant Gold Tinsel. Combining a full 8-ply construction with an impressive 12cm thickness, it provides substantially more volume and visual impact than standard tinsel, making it particularly effective for larger Christmas trees and festive displays. The luxurious metallic gold finish catches and reflects the surrounding light beautifully, creating the unmistakable sparkle of traditional Christmas tinsel. Its mixture of reflective strands creates a rich, full appearance that stands out particularly well against green Christmas foliage. Supplied in a generous continuous 50m length, you can use the tinsel as one long run or simply cut it into the individual lengths required for your display. This makes it particularly useful for larger decorating projects and allows you to decorate multiple areas without having to join together lots of shorter retail-sized lengths. The tinsel is also fire retardant, making it a practical choice for commercial festive displays as well as decorating around the home. Whether you're wrapping a large Christmas tree, decorating railings and displays or creating a substantial commercial installation, this extra thick gold tinsel provides plenty of length, coverage and festive sparkle to create an impressive traditional Christmas display. Product Features • 50m extra thick gold tinsel • Full 8-ply construction • Generous 12cm thickness • Bright metallic gold finish • Highly reflective for maximum festive impact • Supplied in one continuous 50m length • Easily cut to your required lengths • Fire retardant • Ideal for large Christmas trees and displays • Perfect for domestic and commercial decorating Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB
